propositions: Optional configuration key enforce_plan_material_pins must fail open on parse error, emit structured warning plan_material_pin_config_unreadable, and return false without raising.
Derived pin health contract aggregates target status by severity (malformed-pin > stale-pin-missing > stale-pin-drift > current) and reports legacy-unpinned only when input is wholly absent or empty.
When enforcement is enabled, pin drift, missing pinned targets, or malformed pins invalidate the attestation; when disabled, the same observations are reported advisory while valid remains true.
PlanValidityProfile.CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH disable only code freshness while retaining signature, registry, own-material, and pin validity checks; DEFAULT runs all existing checks.
drift_refresh_candidate delegates all validity checks except dependency-hash drift comparison to compute_validity(DRIFT_REFRESH); reopen or prior invalid result immediately returns None.

Re-sign recovery validates review-time related_material from the sidecar through derive_plan_material_pin_health without calling compute_validity; enforcement blocks re-sign on drift, missing targets, or malformed records.
